contributeSub: You've got a phone, you've got a mic.
contributeIntro: Film what you saw. Send it. We publish only after the same two-source check we use on every story. There is no payment in this version.
step1d: Do not put yourself at risk. Do not film people in distress, and stay behind police cordons.
step2d: Tell us what happened, where and when. The video uploads straight to private storage. It does not pass through our web server.
step3d: A person checks the file. Nothing goes on Instagram or this site until it is corroborated.
whatHint: At least a few sentences. What did you see, where, and when?
when: Date and time of the event
videoHint: MP4, MOV, 3GP or WebM. Up to 500 MB and about 5 minutes.
credit: If we publish, credit me as
consentBox: I agree to the Contributor Terms.
uploadClosed: Video uploads are not open on this copy of the site. Storage or the database is not configured yet. You can still read how contributing works.

adminDbOff: The database is not configured, so there are no rows to review. Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
